title: The golden Berk-Hath dividend-rate sensitivity block G10:K14 holds hardcoded values that cannot be correct. Package value should rise with the dividend rate, yet several rows are duplicated or copied from the term table, so a correctly recalculated data table cannot match.
evidence: Golden G11:K11 equals G12:K12 (11152.88…) even though F11=0.075 and F12=0.08. G10:K10 equals G13:K13 (11515.71…) for 0.07 and 0.085. G14:K14 equals the term-table row G20:K20 (12241.37…). The base case I12=10429.31 conflicts with I20=11468.40 and F9=C44=11432.17 for the same 8%/7.3% inputs.
